caption: The drawing depicts a single large jug with a rounded body and a short, cylindrical neck. The jug is primarily a light brown or beige color with subtle shading to suggest its three-dimensional form and texture. On the front of the jug, near the shoulder, there is blue text that reads "WEST TROY N.Y. POTTERY" followed by a small blue design beneath it. Below the text, on the main body of the jug, there is a large, intricate blue floral or abstract design featuring swirling and leaflike patterns centered around a spiral. The base of the jug shows some minor brown discoloration, suggesting either staining or accumulated residue. In the top right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, separate illustration showing an enlarged view of the jug's neck and handle, both rendered in similar colors with close attention to shading and highlights to show their cylindrical and curved shapes. At the bottom left, there is a small linear scale for reference. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Jug
